title: Elimination of Players
statement: The problem counts, for each player and round, the strength permutations eliminating that player in that round, each round removing the weakest survivor unless protected (then the second weakest); n ≤ 5000 summed. Before round i the survivors are one holder plus every player stronger than i, so protection becomes fixed-point matches (strength-k player equals a_k) within runs of equal a, chained across runs into an alternating inclusion-exclusion sum.
